sources.observation: FastAPI is a Python type-hint based API framework emphasizing performance, editor support, OpenAPI/JSON Schema, automatic docs and developer ergonomics; README also points to Typer as its CLI sibling.

Subject-authored PR replaces a long-lived translation token with a short-lived repository-scoped PR Submit token, separates read/write phases, validates with Ruff/ty/YAML/git diff/zizmor, and explicitly says it was created with GPT-5.6 Sol and reviewed by hand.
Subject-authored PR fixes Sponsors Git authentication after token exchange; explicit AI disclaimer says created with GPT-5.6 Sol and reviewed by hand.
Subject-authored FastAPI, Typer and SQLModel PRs migrate automatic labels and remove legacy label checks; each explicitly discloses Codex assistance and manual review.
Owned repositories include long-running Docker deployment images and Python data-model utilities, but repository names alone are not treated as mastery evidence.

scope_boundaries: FastAPI feature documentation establishes product/framework context but does not by itself attribute every feature implementation to the subject.
The recent maintenance PRs explicitly separate AI creation from human manual review; do not erase either role.
Using Starlette/Pydantic/OpenAPI dependencies does not imply authorship or mastery of their internals.
Cross-project workflow maintenance supports project stewardship and validation behavior, not sole implementation of FastAPI/Typer/SQLModel.
